1.0.0.description:
## First Release

[Readme](https://github.com/randomcodegen/CrashNST-AP/blob/main/README.md)

Very strict logic for now which will allow for a lot of out of logic checks in boxsanity

### Randomized:
- Level access and optional entrance shuffle
- Customizable level pools and starting-level counts
- Box, gem, crystal and relic checks
- Collectible rewards and abilities
- Optional Crashsanity movement styles
### Goals:
- Defeat Cortex in selected campaigns
- Defeat every boss in the goal campaigns
- Clear a chosen number of levels
- Collect AP Tokens
### Extras:
- DeathLink
- In-game console, HUD and box markers
- Separate save profiles for each seed
1.0.0.title: First release

1.0.1.description:
[Readme](https://github.com/randomcodegen/CrashNST-AP/blob/main/README.md)

## New Features
- Level text is hidden for locked levels
- Added per-hub marker distance settings and /tint_opacity

## Bugfixes
- Fixed repeated reconnects
- AP progress sync now uses less data
- Improved crystal and gem check detection
- Fixed connection prompt disappearing after alt-tab
- Fixed cross-campaign routing and some crashes on level exit
- Fixed Crashsanity movement restrictions
1.0.1.title: Crash NST AP v1.0.1

1.0.2.description:
**Updated client, APWorld, and a new seed required.**

## New Features
- Added independent hub-area and level-access locks
- Added progressive island and elevator unlocks

## Bugfixes 
- Fixed physical entrance returns, overworld markers, island transitions, and boss-triggered gate unlocks
- Fixed connection settings not saving properly
1.0.2.title: Crash NST AP v1.0.2

1.0.3.description:
## New Features
- Added combined Cortex goals: require tokens, level clears (or both) before unlocking Cortex
- Added Cortex-last mode: requires the campaign’s other bosses before Cortex
- Added an F2 entrance overview with unlocked entrances, shuffled destinations and check counts

## Bugfixes
- Normal bonus-round deaths no longer send DeathLink

**New Cortex settings require the updated client/APWorld and a new seed.**
1.0.3.title: Crash Bandicoot N.Sane Trilogy AP v1.0.3

1.0.4.description:
## New Features

- Continue remembers the last physical hub entrance, including shuffled levels
- CB3's secret-room elevator now spawns automatically

## Bugfixes

- Secret-section crate/gem logic
- Removed incorrect colored-gem requirements from 151 bonus boxes

**Requires the updated client and APWorld and a newly generated seed.**
1.0.4.title: Crash Bandicoot N.Sane Trilogy AP v1.0.4

1.0.5.description:
## New Features

- Choose active hubs separately from the shuffled level pool
- Set one total level count and filter unwanted levels directly through `level_pool`

## Bugfixes

- Fixed secret-stage progress being counted under the wrong hub campaign
- Fixed missing red-gem requirements on two Road to Nowhere crates

**Update both the client and APWorld**
**Regenerate your YAML and seed to use the new options**
1.0.5.title: Crash Bandicoot N.Sane Trilogy AP v1.0.5

1.0.6.description:
## Bugfixes

- Fixed CB2 portals disappearing when a boss activates before its Access item is received
- Fixed the yellow-gem route in Sewer or Later and the gem door in Tomb Time
- Fixed gem-hook failures that could interrupt incoming DeathLinks
- Reduced box-tint overhead and corrected oversized crate outlines
- Reduced CB1 map movement delays after loading and returning from stages

**Existing 1.0.5 seeds remain compatible.**
1.0.6.title: Crash Bandicoot N.Sane Trilogy AP v1.0.6
